data.body:
Evidence for the 2 [non-codebase] criteria. All measurements are read-only, via SSM RunCommand on i-00880b2c7f13527c5, run inside the live MCP container. Times are PST.

AC2: loose objects bounded and commit-graph current.
- Container `rebar-mcp-334295da063a-8092` (image 334295da, the fix commit), 15:50 PST.
- `git count-objects -v`: count 77, packs 4.
- `objects/info/commit-graphs/` split chain written 15:50:33, covering HEAD (307,668 commits). `git commit-graph verify --shallow` exits 0.
- Re-checked in `rebar-mcp-aa1e294069a5-8093` (release 0.15.1, which contains the fix), 16:01 PST: count 93, packs 4, chain covers 307,672 commits.
- Before the repair: 78,737 loose objects, 235 packs, commit-graph from 2026-08-30.

AC3: store-wide position walk inside its 300 s timeout.
- Container `rebar-mcp-aa1e294069a5-8093`, 16:01–16:09 PST.
- Command, the same one `build_position_commit_map` runs: `git -c log.showSignature=false -C /var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets log --diff-filter=A --full-history --no-merges --no-renames --format=%x1e%H --name-only -- '*.json'`.
- Result: rc 0 at 232.4 s (238,717 records) and rc 0 at 222.0 s (238,720 records).
- Earlier, in `rebar-mcp-b878c4be7686-8093` right after the repair, 12:01 PST: 225.6 s and 220.4 s.
- Before the repair: 427.5 s on 2026-11-05, which exceeded the timeout.

The provenance lines in the description name these containers.
